title: Follow the Menorca wine route
location: Binifadet (Sant Lluís) and wineries across the island
description: Menorca only started making wine again two decades ago, and today there are a dozen small wineries scattered across the island. Binifadet, in Sant Lluís, is the easiest way in: a tour, a tasting and a terrace among the vines to stay for lunch. From there you carry on to Vinya Sa Cúdia, Binitord or Son Cremat. Booking is advisable.
whenLabel: All year · harvest in late summer
imageAlt: Barrels and bottles inside a winery
